title: Understanding IV Therapy
summary: A plain-language look at what a mobile IV visit is and what to expect.

children.text: A mobile IV visit brings nursing care to your location. Booking starts with your name and email on this website. Service selection, scheduling and confidential health screening happen on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. Before an IV begins, Shary reviews your screening with you and checks that the service is a good fit. She stays with you throughout the visit.

question: What is mobile IV therapy?
answer: Mobile IV therapy means a registered nurse comes to you and gives your IV drip at your home, office or event, instead of you visiting a clinic or IV lounge. With Avida Luna, that nurse is always Shary Gonzalez, RN, BSN. She reviews your health screening, assesses you in person, places your IV and stays with you until it's done.

question: What services do you offer?
answer: Mobile IV drips (Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's), Energy IV, Athlete Recovery IV, Detox/Hangover IV, Migraine IV, Myers IV and Myers with Chromium IV), IM injections (B12, B-Complex and Glutathione), IV nutrient add-ons, wellness packages, and group and corporate IV events. Restorative services (targeted red light, compression boots and aromatherapy) can be booked on their own or added to an appointment, and our Vitamin Wellness Spray is available to take home.

question: How much does mobile IV therapy cost?
answer: Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's) is $99. Energy IV and Athlete Recovery IV are $180, Detox/Hangover IV and Migraine IV are $190, Myers IV is $199 and Myers with Chromium IV is $240. IM injections are $40 to $50, and IV nutrient add-ons are $35 to $45. Restorative services start at $20, and packages start at $45. Each booking is a one-time visit: no memberships, subscriptions or prepaid series.

question: ¿Hablas español?
answer: Sí. Shary habla inglés y español. Puedes llamarnos o escribirnos en español.

question: How do I book?
answer: For an IV, tap Book and share your name and email. You'll get your booking link right away, then pick your services, a time, and complete your screening and payment on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. Once Shary reviews your screening, you'll be asked to get cleared by our medical provider before your visit. Optional enhancements come after. For red light, compression boots or aromatherapy on their own, send a restorative visit request with a few preferred times and Shary will confirm by text or email.

question: How do I pay?
answer: IVs and IM injections are booked and paid on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. Restorative services, enhancements and the Vitamin Wellness Spray are paid at your visit, by tap to pay or card. For a package that includes an IV, you pay the IV's price on the booking page and the rest of the package price at your visit.

question: Can I add red light, compression boots or aromatherapy?
answer: Yes. Added to an appointment you've already booked, they're enhancement prices: targeted red light (15 minutes) $25, compression boots (30 minutes) $35, aromatherapy $15, and the take-home Vitamin Wellness Spray $35. Booked on their own they're $29, $39 and $20, and the spray is $37. Aromatherapy — duration is based on your selected service and continues throughout that service. Pay at your visit.

question: Do you offer packages or memberships?
answer: We offer wellness packages that combine services in one visit, such as Hydrate & Unwind or Luna Signature Reset. Every package is a one-time booking: there are no memberships, recurring billing or prepaid multi-visit series. Packages with an IV or IM injection include the required medical consultation at no extra charge.

question: What's your cancellation and refund policy?
answer: Our cancellation and refund policy will be posted here.

question: How does an in-home IV visit work?
answer: Three steps: request an appointment (share your name and email, then choose a service and time on our secure booking page), complete a health screening and assessment, and Shary comes to your home, office or event.

question: What happens before my appointment?
answer: Every appointment includes a confidential health screening on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page, and Shary reviews it before your IV begins. Your health information stays there, never on this website.

question: What happens during my appointment?
answer: Shary arrives at your location, reviews your screening with you, and checks your vital signs. She then places your IV and stays with you while it runs. Most of the visit is simply time to sit back and rest.

question: How long does a visit take?
answer: An IV infusion takes about 35–40 minutes. The full appointment takes longer, because it includes your consultation, setup and any enhancements, which are done separately. Targeted red light is 15 minutes and compression boots are 30 minutes. Aromatherapy — duration is based on your selected service and continues throughout that service, so it adds no appointment time.

question: Who comes to my appointment?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse, comes to your appointment herself.

question: Is IV therapy right for me?
answer: Not everyone is a good fit for IV therapy, and that's why every appointment starts with a health screening. If anything in your screening or at your visit suggests an IV isn't right for you, Shary will tell you and suggest you speak with your doctor.

question: Who places my IV, and how is safety handled?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse with more than 17 years of nursing experience, places and monitors every IV herself. She uses sterile, single-use supplies and stays with you for the whole visit.

question: Do you come to Sarasota and Bradenton? Is there a travel fee?
answer: Shary is based in Lakewood Ranch and comes to homes, offices and events in Lakewood Ranch, Sarasota, Bradenton and nearby communities, including Siesta Key, Longboat Key, Palmer Ranch, University Park, Fruitville, Osprey and Bee Ridge. For IV appointments, including those with restorative enhancements, travel is included within a 35-minute one-way drive from her service starting location. Additional travel charges may apply and will be confirmed before booking. Restorative-only appointments have an $8 travel fee, once per appointment.

question: Do you offer group IV therapy or IV parties?
answer: Yes. Shary coordinates mobile IV hydration for workplaces, bachelorette and bridal parties, private celebrations and community events. Each guest is screened individually. Tell us about your event on our Group & corporate page.

question: Which IV drip should I choose?
answer: Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's) is our essential IV: fluids and electrolytes. Athlete Recovery IV adds amino acids and B12 for training days, Energy IV is a blend of amino acids, vitamins and minerals for busy weeks, and Myers IV is the classic Myers cocktail. Not sure? Shary talks it through with you after your screening.

question: What's in a Myers cocktail IV?
answer: The classic Myers cocktail blend of B vitamins, vitamin C, magnesium and calcium, given with IV fluids. Myers IV is $199, and Myers with Chromium IV is $240.

question: Can I get IV therapy at home?
answer: Yes. Every Avida Luna service is mobile. Shary brings everything needed for your IV to your home, office or event in Lakewood Ranch, Sarasota, Bradenton and nearby communities, so there's no clinic or IV lounge to visit.

question: Can I get a B12 shot without an IV?
answer: B12 IM Injection ($40), B-Complex IM Injection ($45) and Glutathione IM Injection ($50) are on our menu. Booking for injection-only appointments opens soon. Every injection starts with a health screening.

question: Can I add vitamins to my IV drip?
answer: Yes. You can add B12 IV Add-On ($35), B-Complex IV Add-On ($40) or Glutathione IV Add-On ($45) to any IV. They're added to your IV, not given as separate shots. Your nurse may suggest other add-ins based on your assessment.

question: Do I need a health screening for services?
answer:
Yes. To keep you safe, medical consultations are required for our treatments:
* IVs & Injections: A telehealth medical consultation is conducted with a medical provider every 6 months.
* Peptide Support: Peptide protocols have separate consultation guidelines. Please check in with Shary to discuss your specific protocol details.

sections.text:
Shary started Avida Luna because she wanted care to feel personal again: one nurse, who knows your name, taking the time to do things properly.

When you book with Avida Luna, Shary is the nurse who shows up. Not a call center, and not a rotating staff. She reviews your screening, assesses you in person, places your IV and stays with you for the whole visit, at your home, your office or your event.

She speaks English and Spanish, so you can talk through your care in whichever language feels better for you.
